data_centres.json.description: All 118 data centre campuses, joined with their best-available coordinate. Use latitude/longitude directly when has_verified_coordinate is true; otherwise fall back to that row's district centroid, computed from your GeoJSON.

groundwater_districts.json.description: Known groundwater stress data for the 29 districts in this project (subset of the person's larger nationwide file). category is already CGWB's official 4-band label (Safe / Semi-critical / Critical / Over-exploited) — use directly for the color gradient on these districts; for all other districts in the nationwide file, derive the same category from stage_of_extraction_pct using cutoffs 70/90/100.

join_key: Join data_centres.json to district boundaries on (state, district). Join groundwater_districts.json to district boundaries the same way.
see_also: agent.md for full build spec, caveats, and flagged data-quality notes.
